label: Flat
why: No hills. The slope only matters once a climb is entered; 2 % is below the steepest grades of roads in level terrain (3–4 %)

label: Rolling
why: Judgement for the climb per 100 km. Slope: just below the steepest grades of main roads in rolling terrain (4–5 %)

label: Hilly
why: Judgement for the climb per 100 km. Slope: between the steepest grades of main roads in rolling and mountainous terrain (5–6 %)

label: Mountain
why: Judgement for the climb per 100 km and the slope: steeper than the steepest grades of mountain freeways (5–6 %), as slower mountain roads are steeper
